summary: Field accumulator: saves the input a2 as the return value, then adds a2 to the running total stored at this[9] (this+0x24) unconditionally, and returns the original input. Called by SeasonScoringInfoUpdater (0x004C2A80) to accumulate session counters.

local_names.a2: value added to the accumulator and returned unchanged
local_names.result: copy of a2 used as the function return value

operations.description: Save the input value: result = a2, so the original argument is preserved for the return.
Accumulate unconditionally: this[9] += a2, i.e. the field at this+0x24 is increased by a2.
Return result, which is the unchanged input a2.
Invoked by SeasonScoringInfoUpdater (0x004C2A80), consistent with accumulating a session scoring quantity.

unresolved: The meaning of the accumulated field at this+0x24 (laps, points, or another session counter) is inferred only from the SeasonScoringInfoUpdater calling context and is not documented in this function.
